flashcard_questions.q: What is variation within a species?
flashcard_questions.a: The differences in characteristics between individuals of the same species.

flashcard_questions.q: What causes genetic variation between individuals?
flashcard_questions.a: Differences in the DNA inherited from their parents.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a mutation in DNA?
flashcard_questions.a: A random change in the sequence of bases.

flashcard_questions.q: Who first proposed natural selection after his voyage on HMS Beagle?
Natural selection: variation → ____ → survival of the fittest → ____
What is selective breeding, also called artificial selection?
flashcard_questions.a: Humans choosing organisms with desirable characteristics and breeding them together.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the main disadvantage of selective breeding?
flashcard_questions.a: It reduces genetic variation, raising the risk of inherited disorders and disease.
The preserved remains or traces of an organism that lived thousands or millions of years ago.

flashcard_questions.q: What is mineralisation in the formation of a fossil?
flashcard_questions.a: Hard parts such as bones and shells are gradually replaced by minerals.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do the oldest rocks contain fossils of only the simplest organisms?
flashcard_questions.a: Simple life forms gradually evolved into more complex ones over billions of years.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is the fossil record incomplete?
flashcard_questions.a: Many early organisms were soft-bodied and decayed completely without leaving a trace.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does a whole bacterial population eventually become antibiotic resistant?
flashcard_questions.a: The resistant survivors reproduce rapidly and pass the resistance allele to all their offspring.

flashcard_questions.q: What is extinction of a species?
flashcard_questions.a: No individuals of that species remain alive anywhere on Earth.

flashcard_questions.q: What caused the mass extinction of the dinosaurs about 66 million years ago?
flashcard_questions.a: An asteroid impact that dramatically changed the global climate.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is a population with low genetic variation vulnerable to extinction?
flashcard_questions.a: No individual carries the alleles needed to survive a new disease or change.
